[SWS_CM_90489] Argument sourceID in E2E_check for method requests
Upstream requirements:
RS_CM_00400, RS_E2E_08541
⌈
For E2E-protected
Method
requests using profiles P04m, P07m, P08m, or P44m, a
reference to a variable to store the
End2EndMethodProtectionProps
.
sourceId
to shall be passed as argument
sourceID
to
E2E_check
.
E2E_check
shall extract
the E2E Source ID contained in the E2E protection header into this variable. This
extracted
sourceID
shall be stored for later use during E2E protection of response
payload (see [SWS_CM_90492]).
⌋
